title: Sept 9 AMSE22 KC-135 refuel German Tornado
description: A KC-135R Stratotanker from the 155th Air Refueling Wing, Nebraska National Guard, refuels two German Tornado, Sept. 9, 2022, during Ample Strike Exercise. Ample Strike allows the Czech Republic, U.S., Allies and partner forces to maximize interoperability, combat effectiveness and survival awareness while operating in a dynamic and simulated high threat environment through operational and tactical training. Successful partnering activities like this result in progressive relationships and enhanced interoperability and lead to tangible, mutual benefits that improve regional security, access and coalition operations during peacetime, contingencies and crises.  (U.S. Air National Guard video by Master Sgt. R. Denise Mommens)
